engines.name: Google Scholar
engines.description: Scrapes Google Scholar results for scholarly literature, with Cited By, All Versions, year-range, review-only, patent and US case-law filters.

params.name: q
params.label: Search query
params.help: Search query. Supports helpers such as author: and source:. Optional when cites is used (then it searches within citing articles). Must not be used with cluster.

params.name: cites
params.label: Cited-by article ID
params.help: Article ID that triggers a Cited By search, e.g. 1275980731835430123. With q, searches within citing articles.

params.name: cluster
params.label: All-versions cluster ID
params.help: Article ID that triggers an All Versions search. Must be used alone: not with q or cites.

params.name: as_ylo
params.label: Year from
params.help: Excludes results before this year, e.g. 2018. Can be combined with as_yhi.

params.name: as_yhi
params.label: Year to
params.help: Excludes results after this year, e.g. 2018. Can be combined with as_ylo.

params.name: scisbd
params.label: Sort by date (last year)
params.help: Limits to articles added in the last year, sorted by date.

params.name: as_sdt
params.label: Search type / patents / court codes
params.help: As a filter (articles only): 0 excludes patents (default), 7 includes patents. As a search type: 4 selects US case law, followed by comma-separated court codes with 4 first, e.g. 4,33,192.

params.name: as_vis
params.label: Citations
params.help: Whether to include citations in results.

params.name: as_rr
params.label: Review articles only
params.help: Whether to show only review articles.

params.name: safe
params.label: SafeSearch
params.help: Adult content filtering level. Google blurs explicit content by default.

params.name: filter
params.label: Similar/omitted results filter
params.help: Toggles the Similar Results and Omitted Results filters.

params.name: hl
params.label: Interface language
params.help: Two or three-letter language code, optionally followed by a region code, e.g. en, es, fr, en-gb, es-419.

params.name: lr
params.label: Limit to languages
params.help: Limits the search to one or more languages, separated by |, format lang_{code}, e.g. lang_fr|lang_de.

params.name: start
params.label: Result offset
params.help: Result offset. 0 (default) is page 1, 10 is page 2, 20 is page 3.

params.name: num
params.label: Results per page
params.help: Maximum number of results, 1 to 20.

pagination.notes: Advance start in steps of num (default 10). Response has pagination and serpapi_pagination objects.

engines.aira_use: Find papers, authors and citation counts to prepare for research/PhD-track roles, interviews and technical credibility.

engines.name: Google Scholar Author
engines.description: Retrieves a Google Scholar author profile: articles, citation table, co-authors and individual article citations.

params.name: author_id
params.label: Author ID
params.help: ID of the author. Get it from the Google Scholar Profiles API / Google Scholar API results or the author's Scholar profile URL.

params.name: hl
params.label: Interface language
params.help: Two or three-letter language code, optionally followed by a region code, e.g. en, es, fr, en-gb, es-419.

params.name: view_op
params.label: View
params.help: Which part of the page to view.

params.name: citation_id
params.label: Citation ID
params.help: Retrieves an individual article's citation. Required when view_op=view_citation. IDs appear in the JSON response.

params.name: sort
params.label: Sort articles
params.help: Sorts the article list. Default is by citation count.

params.name: start
params.label: Result offset
params.help: Result offset. Default 0; 20 is the second page, 40 the third.

params.name: num
params.label: Results per page
params.help: Number of results. Default 20, maximum 100.

pagination.notes: num max 100. Docs do not list response key names; keys below are standard SerpApi output (see gaps).

engines.aira_use: Research a hiring manager, professor or potential collaborator's publications and citation record before an interview or outreach.

engines.name: Google Scholar Cite
engines.description: Returns formatted citations (MLA, APA, Chicago, Harvard, Vancouver) and export links (BibTeX, EndNote, RefMan, RefWorks) for one Scholar result.

params.name: q
params.label: Result ID
params.help: ID of an individual Google Scholar organic result: the result_id field of the Google Scholar API or the serpapi_cite_link.

params.name: hl
params.label: Interface language
params.help: Two or three-letter language code, optionally followed by a region code, e.g. en, es, fr, en-gb, es-419.

engines.aira_use: Copy ready-made citations of papers into a portfolio, CV publication list or cover letter.

engines.name: Google Scholar Profiles
engines.description: Searches Google Scholar author profiles by name or label: of. NOTE: the docs state this API is discontinued because Scholar now requires login for profiles.

params.name: mauthors
params.label: Author
params.help: The author to search for. Helpers such as label: can be used in the query.

params.name: hl
params.label: Interface language
params.help: Two or three-letter language code, optionally followed by a region code, e.g. en, es, fr, en-gb, es-419.

params.name: after_author
params.label: Next page token
params.help: Next-page token (from the previous response's pagination) to retrieve the following page. Takes precedence over before_author.

params.name: before_author
params.label: Previous page token
params.help: Previous-page token (from the previous response's pagination) to retrieve the prior page.

pagination.notes: Token pagination: pass the next token as after_author or the previous token as before_author; after_author takes precedence. Engine is documented as discontinued.

engines.aira_use: Look up researcher profiles (mark as discontinued in the UI) to find author_id values for the Author engine.
engines.deprecated_reason: SerpApi docs state the Google Scholar Profiles API is discontinued because Google Scholar now requires login to view profiles.

engines.name: Google Scholar Case Law

params.label: Case ID
params.help: ID of the case to scrape, taken from Google Scholar API results (e.g. 16467529).

engines.aira_use: Review employment-law and non-compete case precedents when evaluating contracts or workplace disputes.

engines.name: Google Patents
engines.description: Searches Google Patents (and optionally Scholar) with boolean/proximity/wildcard syntax, date, inventor, assignee, country, language, status, type and litigation filters.

params.name: q
params.label: Search query
params.help: Search query. Separate multiple terms with semicolons (;). Supports Google Patents boolean, proximity and wildcard syntax.

params.name: page
params.label: Page
params.help: Page number, default 1.

params.name: num
params.label: Results per page
params.help: Results per page: minimum 10, maximum 100.

params.name: sort
params.label: Sort
params.help: Sort order. Default is relevance. Patent results sort by filing date, Scholar results by publication date.

params.name: clustered
params.label: Cluster by classification
params.help: true groups results by Classification.

params.name: dups
params.label: Deduplication
params.help: Deduplication method.

params.name: patents
params.label: Include patents
params.help: Whether to include Google Patents results.

params.name: scholar
params.label: Include Scholar
params.help: Whether to include Google Scholar results.

params.name: before
params.label: Before date
params.help: Maximum date, format type:YYYYMMDD where type is priority, filing or publication, e.g. priority:20221231.

params.name: after
params.label: After date
params.help: Minimum date, format type:YYYYMMDD where type is priority, filing or publication, e.g. publication:20230101.

params.name: inventor
params.label: Inventor
params.help: Inventor names, comma-separated. Wrap names containing commas in parentheses, e.g. (Doe, John).

params.name: assignee
params.label: Assignee
params.help: Assignee names, comma-separated. Wrap names containing commas in parentheses, e.g. (Tesla, Inc).

params.name: country
params.label: Country codes
params.help: Patent office country codes, comma-separated, e.g. WO,US.

params.name: language
params.label: Language
params.help: Comma-separated languages.

params.name: status
params.label: Status
params.help: Filter by status.

params.name: type
params.label: Type
params.help: Filter by type.

params.name: litigation
params.label: Litigation
params.help: Filter by litigation status.

pagination.notes: page (default 1) and num (10-100). search_information has total_results, total_pages, page_number.

engines.aira_use: Research a target company's patents and inventors to gauge R&D strength, tech focus and interview talking points.

engines.name: Google Patents Details
engines.description: Retrieves full details of one patent or Scholar document: abstract, claims, classifications, citations, family, legal events.

params.name: patent_id
params.label: Patent ID
params.help: patent/<publication number>/<optional 2-letter language>, e.g. patent/US11734097B1/en, or scholar/<scholar ID>. IDs come from Google Patents API results.

engines.aira_use: Read a patent's claims and inventors to understand what a prospective employer actually builds.

engines.name: Google Trends
engines.description: Google Trends data: interest over time, compared breakdown by region, interest by region, related topics and related queries for one or more search terms.

params.name: q
params.label: Search term / topic
params.help: Search term or topic (topic IDs like /m/0663v from Trends Autocomplete). Comma-separate multiple queries: max 5 for TIMESERIES and GEO_MAP, 1 for other types. Max 100 characters per query.

params.name: data_type
params.label: Data type
params.help: Type of Trends data.

params.name: geo
params.label: Location
params.help: Trends location code (e.g. US, GB, IN, US-CA). Default Worldwide. Comma-separated list matching the order of q; multiple locations only for TIMESERIES; empty values not allowed in a list.

params.name: region
params.label: Region granularity
params.help: Only for GEO_MAP and GEO_MAP_0. Default depends on geo; not every option returns results for every geo.

params.name: hl
params.label: Interface language
params.help: Two or three-letter language code, optionally followed by a region code, e.g. en, es, fr, en-gb, es-419.

params.name: tz
params.label: Time zone offset (minutes)
params.help: Offset from UTC+0 in minutes, -1439 to 1439. Examples: 420 PDT, 600 Pacific/Tahiti, -540 Asia/Tokyo, -480 Canada/Pacific.

params.name: cat
params.label: Category
params.help: Google Trends category ID (differs from Trending Now categories). Default 0 (all categories). 488+ categories exist; the most job-relevant are suggested.

params.name: gprop
params.label: Property
params.help: Search property. Omit for Web Search.

params.name: date
params.label: Date range
params.help: Presets: now 1-H, now 4-H, now 1-d, now 7-d, today 1-m, today 3-m, today 12-m, today 5-y, all (2004-present). Custom: 'yyyy-mm-dd yyyy-mm-dd' or 'yyyy-mm-ddThh yyyy-mm-ddThh' (within one week; hours depend on tz). Multiple comma-separated ranges only for TIMESERIES; count must match q and formats must match.

params.name: csv
params.label: Return CSV
params.help: Set true to return CSV results as an array.

params.name: include_low_search_volume
params.label: Include low-volume regions
params.help: Include low search volume regions. Ignored unless data_type is GEO_MAP or GEO_MAP_0.

pagination.notes: No pagination. Result key depends on data_type.

engines.aira_use: Compare demand for skills, job titles and technologies over time and by region to choose what to learn and where to apply.
